why: The spelling and punctuation of the translation, regularized without changing its words. A word is respelt wherever the translation, its notes, and its front and back matter print it as a whole word. A verse's change is made to the words of that verse alone, which must have them once, and to the notes that quote them. Verses' changes stand in groups, each group under the reason its changes share. Each gives its reason.
